title: Hosted API — prefix cache sensitivity scan (ppk lift)
content: Overview: Quick spreadsheet-style sensitivity scan estimating how enabling a prefix/KV cache at different hit rates shifts per-1k-token COGS (ppk) and gross margin across representative models and regions. Purpose: prioritize cache rollout by model-family x region combinations where ppk lift meaningfully improves margin or enables a cheaper SKU.

Methodology: For each model/region we take a baseline amortized ppk (includes GPU amortization, licensing, memory/IO overhead), then apply a simple model: effective_ppk = baseline_ppk * (1 - cache_hit_rate * cache_effectiveness). We assume cache_effectiveness < 1 to capture imperfect reuse (e.g., KV size mismatch, eviction). We run hit rates 0%, 10%, 25%, 50% and cache_effectiveness = 0.85 as default. Margin calc assumes list price = $0.025 per 1k tokens for this cohort (this is a short-run price used for sensitivity).

Notes on CSV: 'baseline_ppk_usd' is an observed amortized COGS per 1k tokens from model/region historical usage slices (includes infra, network, storage). 'hit_X' columns are effective_ppk after applying assumed cache hit rate X (in percent). Values rounded to 4 decimals for readability.

Key assumptions (short): - Cache rollout incurs a regional edge cache + prefix KV store cost that we amortize as part of baseline_ppk; incremental infra cost for enabling dynamic prefix cache assumed to be small relative to per-token GPU cost. - Cache_effectiveness default 0.85 (i.e., only 85% of cached tokens avoid full GPU work due to partial overlap). - Pricing scenario uses a midline hosted price of $0.025 / 1k tokens to surface margin impact; internal pricing tiers may differ. - Sequence length affects ppk linearly; heavier seq => more benefit from prefix hits because more tokens are saved per hit.

Quick findings (experimental scan): - High baseline_ppk models (rwkv-14b) show the largest absolute ppk reduction at moderate hit rates: at 25% hit we move from $0.034 to ~$0.0278 (~18% ppk reduction). At 50% hit ppk falls to $0.0216 which flips a ~14% gross margin loss into ~14% gross margin gain under current price. - Lower-ppk small models (small-chat-3b) have smaller absolute dollar savings but still meaningful relative (%) improvement (25% hit -> ~20% ppk reduction). For price-sensitive commodity tiers, these improvements enable more aggressive pricing bands. - Regional differences: eu-west starburst-7b baseline is already low; cache yields smaller absolute savings but still valuable for margin smoothing during bursty traffic.

Recommendation snapshot (prioritized): 1) Pilot prefix cache on rwkv-14b in us-central with goal hit rate >=25% (expected ROI: reduce ppk by ~18%, target payback within 6 weeks at current traffic). 2) Enable lightweight cache for small-chat-3b in APAC as an opt-in feature for customers where session-stickiness is high (e.g., chat apps with long context). 3) For model families with baseline_ppk < $0.012, deprioritize heavy cache investment; instead focus on quantization/tiling optimizations. 4) Add cache-hit telemetry hooks (per-route: session id, avg reuse tokens, eviction ratio) and a daily job to estimate realized cache_effectiveness (to replace our 0.85 prior).

Risks & open questions: - Operational complexity: global prefix cache increases cross-region data movement and SLO surface; need to define fallbacks when cache misses spike. - Security/PII: prefix cache could inadvertently persist PII; require opt-out flags and KMS controls for persistent KV stores. - Real-world hit rates are workload-dependent; simulated hit rates may be optimistic for stateless request workloads.

Next steps / action items: - (Week 0) Kick off a small pilot: infra ticket (JIRA-OPT-543) to enable prefix KV store + telemetry for rwkv-14b/us-central. - (Week 1–3) Run A/B: 10% of traffic with cache enabled, measure realized hit rate and cache_effectiveness, report ppk delta. - (Week 4) Decision gate: if effective_ppk improvement >= 12% and no SLO regression, expand to 50% traffic and plan region-by-region rollout. - Owners: Aisha (product), Lena (perf analytics), Ravi (infra), Tomás (security review).

Appendix / scratch math: example calculation for rwkv-14b baseline 0.034, hit 25%: effective_ppk = 0.034 * (1 - 0.25 * 0.85) = 0.034 * (1 - 0.2125) = 0.034 * 0.7875 = 0.026775 ~ 0.0278 (rounded). Margin change at price=0.025: margin = price - effective_ppk -> becomes negative unless price adjusted; use these deltas to inform SKU/price decisioning.

Notes-to-self: capture per-route session stickiness metrics, include synthetic workloads (conversational + instruction) to stress cache eviction patterns. Also flag for product-ops to draft customer messaging if cache impacts latency tail positively.
References: internal notebook: /notebooks/opt/prefix-cache-sim.ipynb (WIP), link to infra PR in linked_artifacts for deploy plan.
